## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete problem and the observable change.

## Evidence

List the exact checks executed and results. Distinguish failed, unavailable and unrun checks.

## Review

- [ ] Scope is focused and existing user work is preserved.
- [ ] Tests cover real behavior and failure paths.
- [ ] Documentation and help match the implementation.
- [ ] Capabilities and provider/host compatibility claims have evidence.
- [ ] No secrets, generated noise, invented identities or external links were added.
- [ ] Permissions, dependencies and compatibility impact are explained.
